runbooks.title: Sign-in fails on Gov Hub
steps: Confirm user is on https://hub.themetalayer.org (or their layer subdomain).
Ask for browser and whether popups or third-party cookies are blocked.
If MFA is enabled, confirm TOTP device time is correct.
Escalate if sign-in works on Canopi but not Gov Hub.

runbooks.title: Workgroup join or membership
steps: Ask for workgroup name/slug and layer URL.
For email invites, confirm the user opened the invite link and signed in (any email is fine for DP workgroup invites).
Direct membership changes to workgroup lead or layer admin — support does not override roles.

runbooks.title: Nominations and role appointments
steps: Ask which layer and role (chair, editor, etc.).
Point to layer nominations page and confirm nomination window is open.
Escalate billing or identity disputes to human admin.

runbooks.title: Layer governance and programs
steps: Ask for layer slug and what action failed (create, join, vote).
Check whether user is layer admin vs member.
Escalate canonical governance decisions to layer admins.

escalationRules.when: nominations with legal or billing dispute
